candidates.content: Store agent observations and summaries in a persistent memory store. Retrieve records by relevance and recency. Periodically summarize older records and delete low-value raw observations. Keep important facts and a small working context for the current task.

Use a durable memory store with separate working context, episodic records, and versioned semantic facts. Enforce a 256 MiB total persistent-memory quota, including indexes, summaries, and metadata, plus a 16 KiB working-context cap. Admit writes transactionally only after reserving capacity; reject or evict when capacity is unavailable. Rank eviction by usefulness, recency, and retrieval frequency. Keep provenance links and confidence with each fact; summarize only when the new record costs less than its inputs. Compact periodically and measure size and retrieval usefulness.
